rules.rule:
File nay thuoc `src/sim/` — lop mo phong. Doc `docs/TECH_SPEC.md` muc 1 (Luat 1) va `CLAUDE.md` muc "Ba luat khong duoc pha" truoc khi ket luan.

## Chan cung — bao LOI, khong phai goi y
- **Cam API trinh duyet**: khong `document`, `window`, `canvas`, `navigator`, `localStorage`, `requestAnimationFrame`, `performance.now`, WebGL. `src/sim/` phai chay duoc trong Node thuan (`npm run sim:thu`). Mot lan cham vao la ca lop het test tu dong duoc — day la nguyen nhan lam du an truoc chet sau 43 phien.
- **Cam import len tren**: khong import tu `src/render/`, `src/ui/`, `src/bench/`. Chieu phu thuoc mot chieu: render doc sim, sim khong biet render ton tai.
- **Import phai ghi du duoi `.ts`**: `import { X } from './Y.ts'`, khong phai `'./Y'`. Thieu duoi la build hong.
- **Cam `constructor(readonly x: T)`** (parameter property). Khai bao truong tuong minh trong than class.
- **Cam so can bang trong `.ts`**: moi ti le, gia tien, nguong, toc do, xac suat, thoi gian hoi phai nam trong `data/*.json`. So trong code chi duoc la hang ky thuat (kich thuoc buffer, chi so mang, don vi doi he). Thay so la dai luong game thi bao loi va chi ro no thuoc file `data/` nao.
- **Moi file `.ts` toi da 300 dong**. Vuot thi de nghi tach module, neu ro tach o dau.

## Dung dan mo phong
- Nhip sim la **10 Hz**, tach han khoi vong ve 60 fps. Phan le thoi gian phai duoc giu lai giua hai lan goi, khong duoc lam tron roi bo — troi nhip la sai.
- Moi nguon ngau nhien phai di qua `src/core/Rng.ts` (co hat giong, tai lap duoc). `Math.random()` truc tiep trong `src/sim/` la loi: mo phong het tai lap, het test duoc.
- Vong lap chay moi nhip: de y cap phat trong vong lap (tao mang/object moi moi nhip) — 10 Hz nhan so thuc the la rac lon.

## Chat luong chung
- Loi chinh ta trong ten bien, ten ham, chuoi log.
- Code chet: nhanh dieu kien khong bao gio dung, bien khai bao ma khong ai doc, khoi code comment lai khong co y dinh giu.
- Cam `var`. Cam `==` va `!=`, dung `===` va `!==`.
- Tranh `any`; buoc phai dung thi phai co comment noi ly do.
- Kiem tra null/undefined truoc khi truy cap hoac destructure.
- Cam ternary long nhau.
- Logic nghiep vu phuc tap phai co comment giai thich **tieng Viet** (quy uoc repo: comment tieng Viet, ten bien/ten ham tieng Anh). Dung comment thu hien nhien.
- Logic trung lap giua cac file: de xuat gom vao mot ham dung chung.

File nay thuoc lop ve WebGL tu viet (khong thu vien do hoa ngoai — `docs/TECH_SPEC.md` muc 4).

## Tran hieu nang — vuot tran la LOI, khong phai "toi uu sau" (TECH_SPEC muc 2)
Bao loi neu thay diff day so len qua bat ky tran nao duoi day, hoac mo duong cho no:
- **Lenh ve moi khung hinh ≤ 4** — moi atlas mot lenh, gom het sprite. Them mot `drawArrays`/`drawElements` ngoai vong gom la dau hieu do.
- **Sprite dong moi khung hinh ≤ 5.000**.
- **Atlas trong bo nho cung luc ≤ 4 × (2048×2048)** ≈ 67 MB VRAM.
- **`setPixelRatio` = `min(dpr, 2)`** — dpr 3 tren iPhone gap 2,25 lan cong ve.
- **Moi file `.ts` toi da 300 dong**.

## Bay cua lop ve
- Cap phat trong vong ve: tao mang, object, closure, chuoi moi khung hinh → GC giat hinh. Bao het.
- Doi trang thai GL thua trong vong lap (`bindTexture`, `useProgram`, `enable/disable` lap lai) — gom ra ngoai.
- Tai nguyen GL tao ma khong huy: `createTexture`, `createBuffer`, `createProgram`, `createShader` phai co duong huy tuong ung.
- Vi tri giua hai nhip sim phai **noi suy**, khong duoc nhay theo nhip 10 Hz.
- Nen ve het truoc, vat ve sau (TECH_SPEC muc "Luat ve cho Phase 2").

File du lieu can bang. Day la noi DUY NHAT duoc chua so can bang cua game (CLAUDE.md luat 2) — moi thay doi o day doi truc tiep trai nghiem choi.

## Can soat
- **Tinh nhat quan khoa**: khoa moi them co dung quy uoc dat ten cua cac muc con lai trong chinh file do khong. Khoa go sai chinh ta la loi im lang — code doc ra `undefined` chu khong bao.
- **Tham chieu cheo**: id nhac den file khac (`buildings.json` ↔ `wares.json` ↔ `chains.json` ↔ `provinces.json` ↔ `tech.json`) phai ton tai that. Neu khong tu kiem duoc, noi ro can kiem id nao o file nao.
- **Don vi va bac do lon**: so moi them co cung don vi voi cac muc anh em khong (giay hay nhip, tuyet doi hay ti le). Lech mot bac 10 la thang du.
- **Gia tri vo ly**: ti le am, ti le > 1 o cho dang le la phan tram, thoi gian hoi bang 0 gay vong lap vo han, chia cho 0.
- **Muc bi bo quen**: them mot mat hang/cong trinh ma khong them o cho lien quan (vi du them wares ma khong co chain tieu thu).
- **JSON hop le**: dau phay thua, khoa trung lap, so ghi duoi dang chuoi.
- Khong binh luan ve dinh huong can bang (manh/yeu) tru khi diff tu no mau thuan — do la quyet dinh cua chu du an.

- **Loi nuot im**: `try/catch` rong, hoac `catch` chi `console.log` roi chay tiep.
- **Ghi de file**: ghi de hoac xoa file ma khong kiem tra ton tai truoc.
- **Lenh shell ghep chuoi** tu bien khong kiem soat.
- **Loi chinh ta** trong ten bien, ten ham, chuoi in ra man hinh.
- Code chet, bien khai bao khong ai doc.
